pages.title: 2048 Ball Arena
pages.creator: Yunus Kahramanoğlu – Independent Developer
pages.description: Roll through 2048 Ball Arena collecting numbered balls and merging equal values into bigger ones. Steer clear of division traps and holes while you build your chain. Use speed, magnet, and doubling pickups to get ahead of the computer-controlled rivals and climb the leaderboard.

pages.title: Little Dentist Dash
pages.creator: iclickgames
pages.description: Treat young patients in Little Dentist Dash. Fix chipped teeth, fit braces, and follow the clinic's instructions for each new case. Work carefully through the procedures while keeping the appointments moving to earn rewards.

pages.title: Beat The Zombies
pages.creator: Guangzhou Yomitoo Network Technology Co., Ltd.
pages.description: Fight plant zombies across a series of stages in Beat The Zombies. Guide your fighter through the hostile world and clear the enemies in each area. Watch what is approaching before committing to an attack and work your way through the next group.

pages.title: Try To Count The Boxes Brain Training
pages.creator: Mirra Games
pages.description: Watch the boxes appear in Try To Count The Boxes Brain Training and enter how many you saw. Keep track as they show up, then submit your answer quickly without losing count. Practice alone or compare your speed and accuracy against another player.

pages.title: Ball Craze Sort
pages.creator: minigame
pages.description: Move colored balls between tubes in Ball Craze Sort. Group the balls of each color together and look for temporary space when the one you need is buried. The boards introduce more tubes and colors as you progress.

pages.title: Black Cat Stacking POP
pages.creator: Synk Inc.
pages.description: Tap a tile in Black Cat Stacking POP to clear it along with adjacent tiles of the same color. Clear a large group to bring out a toy mouse that helps remove more pieces. Watch your remaining moves and look for tiles that give you extra turns.

pages.title: Flower Sort
pages.creator: GameBerry Studio
pages.description: Arrange flowers in pots in Flower Sort. Put three of the same type in one pot to grow a bush, then look for the next set that can merge. Plan which flowers to move first so the other pots still have room.

pages.title: Obby Tower
pages.creator: 2Play
pages.description: Climb the tower in Obby Tower Climb. Think. Survive. Time your jumps across moving platforms and watch where you will land before leaving a ledge. The route also interrupts the climb with math questions, so be ready to switch from jumping to solving.

pages.title: Aliens Hunter
pages.creator: Yizhiyuan Network Technology Co., Ltd.
pages.description: Search the city for disguised aliens in Aliens Hunter. Look over the area and decide which targets to choose before you aim and fire. Each round hides aliens in different places, and clearing the correct targets earns rewards.

pages.title: Fortune's Deck Solitaire
pages.creator: Monstera Games
pages.description: Clear three peaks of Tarot-themed cards in Fortune's Deck Solitaire. Look for an exposed card one rank above or below the current card, then choose the move that opens more of the layout. Draw from the deck when the exposed cards leave you stuck.

pages.title: Magic Princess Dress Up Doll
pages.creator: Yiv.Com
pages.description: Create a princess doll from scratch in Magic Princess Dress Up Doll. Choose the doll's look and try clothing and makeup to give the design its own style. Change the pieces as you go until the outfit suits the character you have made.

pages.title: FRAGEN
pages.creator: LUCKY TRY
pages.description: Fight through gun battles in FRAGEN. Choose a mode, move through the combat area, and look for an opening before you fire. Change how you approach the fight when the mode gives you a different objective.

pages.title: Hazmob FPS
pages.creator: Hazmob
pages.description: Prepare a loadout and join team battles in Hazmob FPS. Learn how the routes on each map meet so you can support teammates or catch opponents from another direction. Try different modes or enter ranked play to put your tactics to the test.

pages.title: Candy Maker: Dessert Games
pages.creator: Eccentric Games Studio
pages.description: Solve candy-matching puzzles in Candy Maker: Dessert Games. Move the pieces to set up matches and clear the sweets the puzzle calls for. Keep working through the boards to collect the cakes and other desserts.

pages.title: Wave Chic Ocean Fashion Frenzy
pages.creator: DL-studio
pages.description: Style two friends for the beach in Wave Chic Ocean Fashion Frenzy. Pick swimsuits and accessories for each one, then choose a surfboard or paddleboard to go with the outfit. Give the two looks different details before they head out on the water.

pages.title: Tower of Fall
pages.creator: TuuT
pages.description: Fight enemies while making your way through a tower in Tower of Fall. Collect coins and spend them on outfits or weapon upgrades. Keep going through the tower's hazards and mobs until you reach the final level.

pages.title: Let The Train Go
pages.creator: PuzzleGame.Com
pages.description: Clear the track for a metro train in Let The Train Go. Cars, trucks, and ambulances can move only in the direction they already face. Work out which vehicle has room to leave first and use the space it frees to move the others.

pages.title: Oh My Goth
pages.creator: Gamerina
pages.description: Put together gothic looks in Oh My Goth. Combine pieces inspired by 1980s goth fashion with grunge and fairy-tale details. Try different combinations to see how the outfit changes when you lean into one style or mix several together.

pages.title: Cut The Rope 3D
pages.creator: CHETRUSCA SOFTWORKS S.R.L
pages.description: Help a man escape the room in Cut The Rope 3D. Look at what is holding him up and choose which rope to cut first. Think about where he will fall or swing after each cut so he can get out safely.

pages.title: Crazy Cameraman Skibidi
pages.creator: Instant Games Studio
pages.description: Take on a job from G-Man in Crazy Cameraman Skibidi. Search for the Cameramen from a first-person view and shoot to clear each target. Watch for their special attack as you move through the area and finish the assignment.

pages.title: Color Pixel Shooter
pages.creator: y9-games.com
pages.description: Shoot pixel figures apart in Color Pixel Shooter. Breaking cubes earns money, and collecting gold gives you more to spend. Save up for different weapons and try them as you work through the next set of block-built characters.

pages.title: Loop Master
pages.creator: BestGameSpot
pages.description: Connect segments into closed patterns in Loop Master. Check which ends meet before changing a piece, since a move can join one part of the loop while leaving another open. Solve the layouts one at a time as you work through more than 30 stages.

pages.title: Winter Puzzle
pages.creator: DL-studio
pages.description: Rebuild winter scenes in Winter Puzzle. Put together pictures featuring seasonal activities, cartoon characters, and New Year symbols. Look for lines and colors that continue across two edges to decide which pieces belong together.

pages.title: Burnout Crazy Drift
pages.creator: Vitalitygames.com
pages.description: Control a sliding car on icy ground in Burnout Crazy Drift. Steer into a drift and correct your angle when the car starts to slide wider than you intended. Watch the space ahead so you have time to regain control before the next turn.

pages.title: Highway Road Racing
pages.creator: Royale Gamers
pages.description: Drive through traffic in Highway Road Racing. Look for gaps before changing lanes and keep a clear route as vehicles close in around you. Try the game's challenges and switch to another modified car when you want a different run.

pages.title: Knives Strikes
pages.creator: XiferGames
pages.description: Throw knives into the target in Knives Strikes. Watch the positions of the knives already in it and time the next throw to hit an open spot. Slice the tomatoes as you go and unlock more knives as the levels get harder.

pages.title: Food Venture Master
pages.creator: TrendyGames
pages.description: Build a roadside food business in Food Venture Master. Click to improve the operation and use its coins to grow into a larger trade network. Decide what to upgrade first, and use the speed control if you want the business to move faster.

pages.title: Bus Parking City 3D
pages.creator: vetx
pages.description: Steer a bus into the marked space in Bus Parking City 3D. Give the vehicle room to turn and line it up before pulling in. The later layouts ask for more precise driving as you work through the parking levels.

pages.title: Hugie Wugie Runner
pages.creator: tegagame.com
pages.description: Help Hugie Wugie get away across mountain hills in Hugie Wugie Runner. Watch how the terrain changes as he moves and pick up batteries to keep his power charged. Get through the climbs while staying ahead of the people chasing him.

pages.title: Divide
pages.creator: Gibton
pages.description: Cut a figure into exactly the number of pieces shown in Divide. The display tells you how many cuts you can make and how many pieces you need. Look at where lines will intersect before drawing one so you do not create too many sections.

pages.title: Time Shooter 2
pages.creator: GoGoMan
pages.description: Time moves when you move in Time Shooter 2. Stop to study the room, then step out to dodge bullets, pick up a weapon, or line up a shot. Throw objects at enemies or set off gas cylinders when a direct attack leaves you exposed.

pages.title: Yummy Tales 2
pages.creator: SOFTGAMES – Mobile Entertainment Services GmbH
pages.description: Help Oscar feed farm animals in Yummy Tales 2 by matching fruit and vegetables. Line up at least three of the same kind to clear them. Work through more than 900 boards and take on daily missions for coins or boosters.

pages.title: Apocalypse Moto
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Ride a motorcycle through a world of zombies in Apocalypse Moto. Watch how the bike reacts to the terrain and keep it moving as you get past the undead. Adjust your speed before a rough stretch so you can stay in control.

pages.title: Filled Glass
pages.creator: Fun Best Games
pages.description: Release colored balls into a glass in Filled Glass. Click the area above the container to start the flow and watch where the balls land. Stop when they reach the marked line so the glass ends up at the required level.

pages.title: Boat Dash
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Steer a boat around obstacles in Boat Dash. Look ahead for a clear route and move toward power-ups such as bubbles and star badges when you can reach them. See how far you can keep the boat going.

pages.title: Ball Toss Puzzle
pages.creator: Isaske Games
pages.description: Fill every space in Ball Toss Puzzle. Tap a red ball to send it onto the board, where it skips over occupied spaces to reach the next opening. Decide which balls to launch first so you can cover the whole layout across 50 puzzles.

pages.title: Slap King
pages.creator: GamingStars
pages.description: Trade slaps with opponents in Slap King. Wait for the right moment before you click or tap to strike. Stay in the contest when the other side hits back and try to knock out each rival as you move through the tournament.

pages.title: Dumper Trucks Jigsaw
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Rebuild pictures of dumper trucks in Dumper Trucks Jigsaw. Drag the shuffled pieces into position and use details like the bed, tires, and background to work out where edges meet. Keep placing pieces until the full truck picture is restored.

pages.title: Cube ShapeUp!
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Swap blocks to put each puzzle back together in Cube ShapeUp! Look for details that line up across block edges and use them to find the right positions. Work quickly as you move through the levels and try to reveal each complete design.

pages.title: Sniper Wolf Hunter
pages.creator: mastergame
pages.description: Track animals and line up rifle shots in Sniper Wolf Hunter. Use the keyboard arrows to move and the mouse to control the gun. Some hunts put you on a moving truck, where the changing view makes it harder to keep a target in your sights.

pages.title: Solitaire Classic
pages.creator: 6woo.com
pages.description: Clear the card peaks in Solitaire Classic. Take exposed cards one rank above or below the active card and look for a move that uncovers another useful play. Draw from the deck when nothing fits and work toward clearing the board.

pages.title: Mega Ramp Stunt Cars
pages.creator: Matrix Info Service
pages.description: Drive over high ramps in Mega Ramp Stunt Cars. Choose a vehicle, then steer along the narrow track and line up your jumps. Use the speed booster when you need extra momentum and give yourself time to correct the car before landing.

pages.title: Axe Master
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Throw hatchets at moving targets in Axe Master. Aim for the bull's-eye while avoiding the skulls and making each axe count. Land quick, accurate shots to build a combo and keep going as the game introduces boss levels.

pages.title: Tap Tap Covid Girl
pages.creator: gameworld
pages.description: Tap to send the girl upward in Tap Tap Covid Girl. Time each jump to stay in the air and slip past the obstacles ahead. See how far you can get before a collision ends the run.

pages.title: Totem Match 3
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Drag totem symbols into rows in Totem Match 3. A line of three or more matching symbols clears and earns points and time. Keep watching the board after each match so you can find another group before the clock runs down.

pages.title: Fantasy Jigsaw Deluxe
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Assemble scenes with dragons, unicorns, and wizards in Fantasy Jigsaw Deluxe. Choose a difficulty and fit the pieces into a complete picture. Use a recognizable creature or a line in the landscape to work out where nearby pieces belong.

pages.title: Blocky Wars Advanced Combat SWAT
pages.creator: BestCrazyGames.com
pages.description: Fight soldiers and zombies in Blocky Wars Advanced Combat SWAT. Join friends online or play through the offline levels. Try modes such as Gun Game, Survival, and team deathmatch, and switch weapons as the fights change.

pages.title: Color Jump
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Rotate a colored polygon in Color Jump so the side facing the incoming ball matches its color. Use the mouse or arrow keys to make the change in time. A mismatch ends the game, so check the next ball before rotating again.

pages.title: Zombie Lucknut
pages.creator: Arcade Lemon
pages.description: Summon zombies onto the city streets in Zombie Lucknut. Tap the zombie icons to send out the undead and go after the people who are out at midnight. Choose which zombies to call as you work through the city.

pages.title: Spill IT
pages.creator: Fat Boy Studio
pages.description: Drop balls to tip over glasses in Spill IT. Move a ball into position and choose where it should land so the impact knocks the glass over. Try another drop point if the first hit leaves it standing.

pages.title: Infinite War 2020
pages.creator: TechionicsInc
pages.description: Score points by taking out opponents in Infinite War 2020, a first-person deathmatch. Move through the area and use the scope when you need to line up a shot. Keep track of where other fighters are coming from as you try to win the match.

pages.title: Panda Air Fighter
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Fly with Ironpaw in Panda Air Fighter and fight off goblin invaders. Use the mouse to guide the aircraft through the battle. Clear enemies as you work toward the boss monster threatening Mooshmooland.

pages.title: Box Run
pages.creator: GameNing
pages.description: Bring boxes of the same color together in Box Run. Use the touch-and-hold control to time the contact and earn points for each match. Watch the colors carefully, since letting different boxes touch ends the run.

pages.title: MergeWorld.io
pages.creator: Instant Games Studio
pages.description: Develop a collection of cars in MergeWorld.io. Use the mouse to combine matching vehicles and work toward more advanced models. Keep merging the cars you have as you build up the collection.

pages.title: Hyper Back to School
pages.creator: Polygon Game Studio
pages.description: Search a chaotic classroom in Hyper Back to School. Look for your belongings among the clutter and pick them out as you scan the scene. Check the details around each object when the next item is hard to spot.

pages.title: Clash of Orcs
pages.creator: BeedoGames
pages.description: Deploy orcs in real time in Clash of Orcs and try to destroy the enemy base. Choose a mix of units that can support one another, then watch how the opposing force responds. Time each deployment for when it can help push the attack forward.

pages.title: Happy Burger Shop
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Fill burger orders in Happy Burger Shop. Look at what the customer asks for, then choose the ingredients and assemble the burger. Work through the levels as the shop gives you more orders to complete.

pages.title: Connect Lines
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Join pipe pieces into a continuous route in Connect Lines. Check which direction each opening faces and adjust the pieces to line up their ends. Follow the connection across the board to find any gaps that are still open.

pages.title: Stars Ascend
pages.creator: Seepia Games
pages.description: Tap to jump and dash through the ruins in Stars Ascend. Watch the route ahead and time each move to get past hazards. Use the magic you find to make your way through the remains of a forgotten civilization.

pages.title: Back To School Memory
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description: Turn over school-themed tiles in Back To School Memory and look for identical pictures. Remember each tile's position when a pair does not match so you can use it later. Clear the pairs across four levels and try to use fewer turns.

pages.title: Coach Bus Simulator
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Choose a bus in Coach Bus Simulator and drive through its levels. Give the vehicle enough room to turn and watch its position as you follow the route. Try another bus skin when you want to change the look of your vehicle.

pages.title: Super Baseball
pages.creator: Super Appli
pages.description: Time your swing against the pitcher in Super Baseball. Hit the ball at the sweet spot for a home run. The pitches become harder to hit as you play, so watch each delivery and see how high a score you can reach.

pages.title: Princess Flame Phoenix
pages.creator: DL-studio
pages.description: Create a superhero outfit for Jina in Princess Flame Phoenix. Try fitted suits, high boots, and fire-themed accessories, then choose makeup and a hairstyle to match. Give the princess a look that suits her new powers.

pages.title: Mathematic Game For Kids
pages.creator: Freelance
pages.description: Solve arithmetic problems against a three-second countdown in Mathematic Game For Kids. Look at the numbers and choose the correct answer before the time is up. Keep going to see how many questions you can get right.

pages.title: Fruit Farm
pages.creator: Webgameapp
pages.description: Work through fruit puzzles in Fruit Farm. Look at how the fruit is arranged and choose a move that brings matching pieces together. Keep checking what changes on the board so you can find the next useful match.

pages.title: Umbrella Down
pages.creator: Webgameapp
pages.description: Descend with an umbrella in Umbrella Down. Watch what is below and use the umbrella to control the fall. Time your movement around obstacles so you can keep getting farther down the course.

pages.title: Viking Wars 2 Treasure
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Collect diamonds while dueling in Viking Wars 2 Treasure. Each gem counts as a point, and the first Viking to five wins. Watch for power-ups falling into the arena and grab one when it gives you a better chance to reach the next diamond.

pages.title: Happy Glass
pages.creator: Webgameapp
pages.description: Guide water into a glass in Happy Glass. Look at the space between the source and the container and work out a path for the water. Adjust the route when the flow misses the glass and try to fill it enough to pass.

pages.title: Magical Pony Caring
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Care for a busy pony in Magical Pony Caring. Give her a bath and treat her wounds before she returns to her duties. Finish the makeover by choosing an outfit for her to wear back in the rainbow kingdom.

pages.title: Dino Digger
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Dig up dinosaur bones in Dino Digger and fit them together into a 3D skeleton. Look at where each bone belongs as you build the dinosaur. See the completed skeleton come to life when the pieces are assembled.

pages.title: Paper Snakes
pages.creator: BeedoGames
pages.description: Steer a paper-themed snake in Paper Snakes and grow by consuming what you find in the arena. Watch the routes other snakes are taking and look for room to turn before they close in. Choose a different snake when you want to start another run.

pages.title: Shoot Robbers
pages.creator: YAKPI
pages.description: Aim at the robbers in Shoot Robbers and fire as they come into view. Keep watching for the next target before it gets a chance to attack. Take each shot when you have a clear line and try to survive the encounter.

pages.title: Oracle
pages.creator: The Ardents
pages.description: Move the heroes to their destinations in Oracle. Check the route ahead for obstacles and enemies before choosing where to go. Clear enemies that block the way and make sure each hero can reach the point they need.

pages.title: Zombies vs Finger
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Smash zombies as they advance in Zombies vs Finger. Watch for the next undead attacker and tap before it gets through. Keep moving your attention across the screen as you try to hold back the invasion.

pages.title: Dotted Girl Fashion Blog
pages.creator: SisiGames
pages.description: Choose outfits and photo setups for Dotted Girl Fashion Blog. Put together a look for each article and see how it works in the photo. Collect the bills that appear after each stage to earn money for the blog.

pages.title: Princess Spring Shopping Sale
pages.creator: Games Banner Network
pages.description: Shop with Elsa and Anna in Princess Spring Shopping Sale. Try on dresses, skirts, and tops, then pick shoes, jewelry, and accessories. Move between the shops and mix pieces to give each princess her own spring look.

pages.title: Plinko Game
pages.creator: Code This Lab srl
pages.description: Place a virtual bet in Plinko Game and choose a tube to drop your chip. Follow the chip as it falls toward the pockets below. The pocket it lands in determines the payout, so try a different starting position on another drop.

pages.title: 2018 Soccer Cup touch
pages.creator: YO-YOgames
pages.description: Pick one of 32 national teams in 2018 Soccer Cup touch and take it into the tournament. Try to create a clear chance on goal while keeping the other side away from yours. Win matches to work toward first place.

pages.title: Duel Hit
pages.creator: webofgrafix
pages.description: Shoot electrons into orbit in Duel Hit. Watch where the ones already in orbit are moving before you fire. Time each shot to fit another electron into the available space without letting them collide.

pages.title: Cupcakes Chef
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Bake cupcakes with the princess in Cupcakes Chef. Follow the cooking steps to prepare the treats, then choose how to decorate them. Try different finishing touches once the cupcakes are ready.

pages.title: Blackjack King
pages.creator: Happylander Ltd
pages.description: Play against the dealer in Blackjack King. Choose whether to hit, stand, double, or split based on the cards you have. Aim to finish closer to 21 than the dealer without going over.

pages.title: TINY TOWN
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Build houses and manage resources in TINY TOWN. Click buildings to develop the settlement and use the money it earns for upgrades. Set taxes and rations with your residents' happiness in mind as you try to grow the population.

pages.title: Neon Bathing Suits
pages.creator: Unify Media Inc.
pages.description: Design a swimsuit for Lisa in Neon Bathing Suits. Choose a shape and combine bold colors to give it a neon look. Help Lisa finish getting ready for her trip to the yacht once you have settled on the design.

pages.title: Lightning Cards
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Play cards as quickly as you can in Lightning Cards. Watch for a card you can use and click it before your opponent takes the next opportunity. Keep the pace up as you race to finish first.

pages.title: Block Movers
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Guide the green block to the exit in Block Movers. Check how the other blocks are positioned before making a move. Work out which pieces need to move first so the green block has a route out.

pages.title: Hijab Salon
pages.creator: Unify Media Inc.
pages.description: Design a veil for a client in Hijab Salon. Start by choosing a solid color for the inner head wrap, then work on the visible layers of the design. Try combinations that bring the colors together in the finished look.
